name: paywhere-smb
description: Small-business finance workflows run against your bank through the Paywhere connector plus QuickBooks (read-only), Gmail (drafts only) and Google Calendar: pay bills behind one approval, payroll headroom, the sales-tax reserve, sweeping spare cash to savings, vendor payment timing, profit-to-cash bridge, big-purchase decision, credit readiness, tax-season prep, and two scheduled agents. Six tool calls or fewer per skill; payments stage as proposals approved on the bank's /confirm page.
